name: Essentials
description: The fonts Dhivehi documents actually use: ModFaruma and Faruma, MV Ilham, MV Faseyha, MV A Waheed (MV Eamaan XP), the Bismi and A_Nishan symbol fonts, MV Randhoo and Noto Sans Thaana. MV Boli, the other common one, comes with Windows.

name: Unicode originals
description: Everything except the pre-Unicode fonts fonts.mv remapped (old A_ fonts and similar).

name: Openly licensed
description: Only fonts under an explicit open license (OFL, Creative Commons BY or BY-SA), safe to redistribute.

name: Official
description: Text faces in the Faruma tradition, for documents: letters, notices, books and reports.

name: Artistic
description: Decorative and headline fonts: outlines, shadows, pixel and stylised Thaana.

name: Novelty
description: Experimental and constructed designs: pixel, geometric and other unusual takes on Thaana.

name: Webfont kit (Essentials)
description: The Essentials as WOFF2 with a ready-made fonts.css, for self-hosting.

name: Webfont kit (Full suite)
description: Every family as WOFF2 with a ready-made fonts.css, for self-hosting.

name: Legacy
description: Every pre-Unicode font in the archive, exactly as published, with Thaana on Latin keys. Only for opening old documents: for new text, type in Unicode and use the fonts on this site. The converter turns old text into Unicode.
